settled-x402 0.9.1: check x402 endpoints against Settled before paying

Usage:
  npx settled-x402 check <url> [--network <name>] [--post] [--json] [--pass <token>]
      Read the endpoint's 402 quote (nothing is paid) and ask Settled about it.
      --network picks the option you would pay on (default: the network Settled has on record).
      Exit code: 0 pay, 2 caution, 3 avoid, 4 unknown, 1 usage or internal error.
  npx settled-x402 spend [--budget-file <path>]
      Today's tally from the spend ledger a guard with dailyBudgetUsd keeps (default: SETTLED_BUDGET_FILE,
      else ~/.settled-x402/spend.json): what the guard let through, per call, with each call's loot rarity.
  npx settled-x402 pass [--pass-file <path>] [--json]
      The pass a guard with renew keeps (default: SETTLED_PASS_FILE, else ~/.settled-x402/pass.json): its term,
      when it expires, when it was bought. Nothing is bought here; a guard with renew does that.
  npx settled-x402 screen [<file>] [--json]
      The response screen on a file, or on stdin: does the text carry instructions aimed at an agent
      (overrides, requests for keys, payment steering, "do not tell the user", hidden text)? The same
      patterns withSettled() applies to every paid answer. Exit code: 0 clean, 3 suspicious, 1 error.
  npx settled-x402 proxy [--port 4021] [--daily-budget-usd 5] [--max-usd-per-call 0.25] [--only-hosts a.com,*.b.com] [--dedupe-window-s 120]
      A local payment proxy for tools that shouldn't hold a wallet key (n8n, scripts, other agents): it holds the
      key and pays through the guard; callers send POST /pay {url, method, headers, body} with a bearer token.
      Key: SETTLED_PROXY_KEY, --key-file <path>, else ~/.settled-x402/proxy-key (a dedicated wallet with a small
      float of USDC on Base, never your main one; without a key it prints how to make one).
      Token: SETTLED_PROXY_TOKEN, --token-file, else one is made in ~/.settled-x402/proxy-token. The daily budget
      defaults to $5 (--daily-budget-usd none to lift it). The same request (method, URL and body, or its
      Idempotency-Key) is paid once inside --dedupe-window-s (120; 0 turns it off): a retry gets the first answer.
      Needs @x402/fetch, @x402/evm and viem installed:
      npx -p settled-x402 -p @x402/fetch@2 -p @x402/evm@2 -p viem@2 settled-x402 proxy
  npx settled-x402 mcp [--pass <token>]
      Run Settled's MCP server over stdio, for Claude Desktop, Cursor and other stdio clients.
  npx settled-x402 skill [install] [--global | --to <dir>]
      The settled-x402 Agent Skill (SKILL.md, references/, scripts/): the same rules as this guard,
      for agents that read skills instead of calling code. 'skill' prints where the files are;
      'skill show' prints SKILL.md; 'skill install' copies the folder into this project's
      .claude/skills/ (Claude Code and the Claude Agent SDK read it from there), into
      ~/.claude/skills/ with --global, or into any folder with --to <dir>.
  npx settled-x402 --version

Environment: SETTLED_PASS (a Settled pass; without it, the pass a renewing guard keeps in ~/.settled-x402/pass.json is used),
  SETTLED_BASE_URL, SETTLED_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS=1.
Docs: https://settled.tools/for-agents
